{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for invalid values in customer_age
invalid_age_mask = sales_df['customer_age'] < 0
print(f"Number of invalid (negative) ages: {invalid_age_mask.sum()}")

# Filter out invalid ages
valid_ages = sales_df.loc[~invalid_age_mask, 'customer_age']

# Compute mean of valid ages
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age}")"}
